response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but lacks nearly all core requirements for this embedded networking security role: no native-level Japanese proficiency, minimal professional C experience (one brief stint at National Instruments), no Linux kernel investigation or source modification experience, and no background in L2/L3 networking, switch products, or security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X.
strengths: 15+ years of broad software development experience across multiple stacks
Some low-level systems exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux)
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions)
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement (native level)
No embedded firmware, Linux kernel, or network switch development experience
No demonstrated knowledge of required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption/key exchange)
